svg.aria-label: Approaches to executing multiple threads, shown as issue slots (columns) per clock cycle (rows), coloured by thread A to D, blank when idle: single-threaded scalar; interleaved multithreading scalar, switching thread every cycle; blocked multithreading scalar, switching on a long stall; superscalar with one thread, leaving many slots empty; interleaved multithreading superscalar; simultaneous multithreading, filling slots from several threads in one cycle; and a chip multiprocessor, with two cores each running its own thread
svg.text: each column = one issue slot · each row = one clock cycle · letters = threads A–D · blank = wasted slot
